text:
deploy-bot: Wave-44 kickoff: api/runtime/console/router in change-window 04:00-05:00Z. canary 5% us-east-1.

sam: console will switch payload envelope field `client_id` -> `cid`. runtime accepts both for now but we should pin runtime to prevent mismatches.

nina: added short note in PR, not on confluence. pls paste confluence link here before unpin.

own: router has an optional strict-envelope flag. we should hold enabling until console confirms. proposed flow: 1) pin runtime v3.8.2 2) console publishes confluence + support blurb 3) smoke test 100 mixed envelopes 4) staged router roll with flag.

pat: rollback criteria suggestion: if error 400s >0.8% for 10m OR p95 latency +250ms for 10m -> rollback.

quinn: /deploy pin runtime v3.8.2 --wave wave-44 --reason "payload envelope rename"

deploy-bot: Pin acknowledged. canary bumped to 10%. obs hooks active.

sam: confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood/releases/wave-44/envelope-rename (publishing).

own: smoke test planned. will post pass/fail.

quinn: can we keep router hold until smoke test + confluence URL in thread?

pat: agreed. if smoke fails we rollback runtime pin immediately.

own: smoke test result: 100/100 mixed requests returned 200 across canary nodes. logs sanitized. :white_check_mark:

sam: confluence published. link above now final.

own: initiating staged router rollout with strict-envelope enabled: stages 10,40,100.

deploy-bot: /deploy roll router v2.12.8 --stages 10,40,100 --wave wave-44 --flag strict-envelope=true

quinn: leaving runtime pin for 1 hour post router full deploy, then unpin if stable.

deploy-bot: wave-44 status: in-progress; runtime pinned v3.8.2; router rolling v2.12.8 (stage 10%).
